biology.excretion-describe.0003.all: two kidneys connected by ureters to the bladder; bladder stores urine; urethra carries urine out; kidneys supplied by renal artery and drained by renal vein

biology.excretion-diag-mcq.0001.all: depends on diagram (A usually glomerulus/Bowman's capsule)

biology.excretion-explain.0007.all: more sweating so water lost; blood water potential falls; more ADH released; collecting duct more permeable, more water reabsorbed; less, more concentrated urine

biology.excretion-explain-multi.0005.b: water is reabsorbed from filtrate (PCT, loop, collecting duct) but urea is not reabsorbed (much), so urea concentrated

biology.excretion-ext.0006.all: ultrafiltration in glomerulus/Bowman's capsule under high pressure: urea, water, glucose, ions filtered; selective reabsorption of glucose in PCT; water reabsorption controlled by ADH in collecting duct (osmoregulation); urea excreted in urine to bladder via ureter
